evals.name: Exact duplicate across specialists
evals.input: SEC reports an unauthenticated legacy endpoint. BOUND reports the same route is publicly mounted without the required guard. Same mechanism and unauthorized read.

evals.name: Same subsystem is not duplicate
evals.input: REL reports export dispatch loss before queue admission. PERF reports 100k-row export memory materialization.

evals.name: Shared remediation is insufficient
evals.input: Two findings can both be improved by adding a transaction, but they involve different operations, invariants, and failure outcomes.
expected: relationship based on mechanism not remediation

evals.name: Compound finding split
evals.input: One source finding says a public endpoint lacks authentication and also returns raw internal exception details.
expected: one source may map to multiple RT IDs

evals.name: Do not split consequences of one race
evals.input: A uniqueness check-then-insert race throws a constraint violation and aborts the enclosing business transaction.
expected: keep as one defect when same root mechanism

evals.name: Historical closed is not fixed proof
evals.input: A closure report says CH-001 CLOSED but no current verification is supplied.
expected: do not classify FIXED from closure prose alone
bounded current verification or UNVERIFIED CURRENT STATE

evals.name: Possible regression requires uncertainty
evals.input: Defect existed, was later marked fixed, and appears current again, but no evidence proves it was ever actually absent.

evals.name: Reopened defect strong evidence
evals.input: Historical defect existed; later evidence proves mechanism absent; current revision proves the same mechanism present again.

evals.name: Current status separate from provenance
evals.input: A defect reported by an older independent audit still exists now.

evals.name: Old same-family persistence
evals.input: Current RivetSpec finding matches an older RivetSpec finding and was never verified fixed.

evals.name: Historical only fixed
evals.input: Old finding is verified absent in current code after remediation.

evals.name: Stale removed path
evals.input: Historical finding points to a feature/route removed from the current product contract; no equivalent current path exists.

evals.name: Finding versus resilient conflict
evals.input: STATE reports a producer race; REL says a consumer-side queue lock prevents it.
expected: control does not invalidate different lifecycle phase

evals.name: Control really invalidates finding
evals.input: A source claims duplicate creation, but current path performs an atomic upsert under a matching unique key and handles conflict on the same operation.

evals.name: Title similarity not enough
evals.input: Two findings are both titled Notification race but one concerns preference first-write uniqueness and the other notification dedup rollback.

evals.name: Different titles same defect
evals.input: SEC calls it legacy route unauthorized read; Chaos calls it curious user can open old Brand API. Same route, missing auth, same data.

evals.name: Canonical claim narrowing
evals.input: One source claims all private metadata leaks; current evidence proves only email and account ID are exposed.
expected: canonical claim limited to proven fields

evals.name: Severity vote prohibited
evals.input: Sources rate the same defect P1, P2, and P3; current blast radius is bounded and recoverable.
expected: do not average or majority vote

evals.name: Duplicate count does not amplify severity
evals.input: Five reviewers independently find the same bounded P3 defect.
expected: severity not raised because of reviewer count

evals.name: Known defect does not lower severity
evals.input: A known persistent defect has material current P2 impact.

evals.name: Question scoped verification
evals.input: To decide if two findings are duplicates, only the current queue handoff and DB write path need inspection.
expected: do not launch broad reliability review

evals.name: Incidental new bug
evals.input: While checking duplicate identity, triage notices an unrelated missing authorization check not present in any source finding.

evals.name: Every source accounted
evals.input: 10 source findings produce 6 canonical findings, 1 split, 2 fixed historical dispositions, and 1 unresolved candidate.

evals.name: Unresolved duplicate relationship
evals.input: Two historical reports describe similar effects but neither identifies code path or root mechanism and current behavior cannot be resolved narrowly.

evals.name: Single current finding simple triage
evals.input: One current source report contains one well-evidenced finding, no history and no overlaps.

evals.name: Artifact role classification
evals.input: A current RivetChaos report and an older audit are both present under docs/reviews.
expected: do not treat every review file as current input

evals.name: No majority vote
evals.input: Four reports say FINDING and one says ALREADY RESILIENT with a concrete control.

evals.name: Partial overlap producer vs rollback
evals.input: One finding is a uniqueness race; another describes broader outer-transaction rollback from the same error plus separate recovery consequences.
expected: consider PARTIAL OVERLAP unless identity fully matches

evals.name: Same file different defects
evals.input: Two reports reference the same table/controller, but one requires conflict-safe insert and the other requires cascade deletion.

evals.name: Fixed status current verification
evals.input: Old finding says a route lacked auth. Current route has mandatory auth and no alternate mount exists.
expected: FIXED if bounded verification supports absence

evals.name: Self-referential test not enough
evals.input: Generated OpenAPI checker compares generated output against the same generator logic; actual runtime route differs.

evals.name: Deployment topology uncertainty
evals.input: A race requires multiple scheduler instances but deployment evidence does not establish multiplicity.

evals.name: Ordinary request concurrency
evals.input: A race requires two ordinary supported requests against the same key; implementation lacks serialization/conflict handling.
expected: can verify without production collision logs
do not require hypothetical deployment multiplicity

evals.name: Ready handoff
evals.input: Canonical current defect has supported invariant, mechanism, reachability, impact, current evidence, and resolved identity.

evals.name: Blocked contract ambiguous
evals.input: Mechanism is clear but whether behavior violates supported product intent cannot be distinguished.

evals.name: Blocked current state
evals.input: Historical finding identity is clear but current runtime state cannot be checked.

evals.name: Blocked insufficient evidence
evals.input: Source finding omits invariant, code path, and reproducible behavior; bounded verification cannot locate it.

evals.name: No remediation
evals.input: While verifying a current defect, the fix is obvious and one-line.

evals.name: Superseded compound source
evals.input: One old finding is decomposed into two better current canonical defects.

evals.name: Novelty scope discipline
evals.input: No prior reports are available but repository history before the current review is unknown.
expected: scope GENUINELY NEW to reviewed history or use INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE

evals.name: Framework recovery invalidates upstream finding
evals.input: A source reports missing create/dispatch atomicity, but current framework and queue semantics guarantee recovery of the claimed failure without the alleged bad outcome.

evals.name: Missing preferred control is not a defect
evals.input: A source points out that a preferred cleanup control is absent, but no current supported invariant is violated and no concrete undesirable behavior is established.
expected: absence alone does not prove a finding

evals.name: Historical false-positive validator requires current check
evals.input: An old validator calls a source finding a false positive, but the current code path has changed and current implementation evidence is available.
expected: use historical validator as context only
do not accept or reject from historical prose alone

evals.name: Rejected source remains fully accounted
evals.input: A current source finding fails the invariant and concrete-behavior validity checks during bounded verification.

evals.name: All duplicate sources share one false positive
evals.input: Three sources describe the same alleged missing cleanup behavior, but current queue redelivery semantics prevent the alleged stuck-work state.

evals.name: Valid and invalid overlapping sources
evals.input: Two overlapping sources describe the same workflow; one has current evidence of a violated invariant and concrete bad behavior, while the other alleges a missing control without proving either.
expected: retain the valid source finding if its gate passes
reject or mark non-current the invalid source claim

evals.name: Bounded performance inefficiency defaults P3
evals.input: Duplicate unpaginated per-user reads create deterministic extra work, but there is no measured severe impact or supported-limit failure.
expected: real CURRENT defect may survive validity gate
do not amplify to P2 without independent material impact

evals.name: Unknown unbounded provider input defaults P3
evals.input: Input is unbounded before expensive provider work, but production token, latency, cost, and supported-limit magnitude are unknown.
expected: quantitative uncertainty does not invalidate a verified defect
do not assign P2 from provider/resource involvement alone

evals.name: Material unauthorized disclosure supports P2
evals.input: A reachable unauthenticated operation deterministically discloses another user's private data across the trust boundary.
expected: validity gate passes if current evidence supports the path
canonical severity P2 may be independently justified

evals.name: Deterministic rollback or corruption supports P2
evals.input: A supported operation deterministically rolls back durable business state incorrectly and can corrupt or lose data.
expected: canonical severity P2 may be independently justified
basis is deterministic material state/data harm
do not rely on reviewer severity labels

evals.name: Fail-closed blocked workflow defaults P3
evals.input: A supported workflow is blocked by a deterministic defect, but it fails closed without data, security, or trust-boundary harm.
expected: real CURRENT defect if validity gate passes
do not amplify to P2 from workflow importance alone

evals.name: Reviewer count does not amplify severity
evals.input: Several reviewers independently report the same bounded defect; current evidence shows limited recoverable impact and no material P2 basis.
expected: one canonical finding when identity matches
reviewer count is not severity evidence

evals.name: Reformatted copy is not independent
evals.input: Report A contains finding X. Report B is a reformatted and paraphrased copy of A with a different filename and finding ID; no independent evidence was produced.
expected: B is DERIVATIVE or SHARED ORIGIN evidence
A and B do not count as two independent corroborating sources
file count does not inflate confidence, current state, or severity

evals.name: Same scanner output is one lineage
evals.input: Several reports contain the same finding because they all ingest the same scanner output, although the reports have different filenames and source IDs.
expected: scanner-derived reports constitute one evidentiary lineage
no majority or source-count inference is made

evals.name: Derivative history plus independent current verification
evals.input: Historical report A contains finding X. Historical report B copies A. Current source inspection independently confirms X.
expected: A and B are one historical evidentiary lineage
current inspection is independent current evidence
current status may be established from the independent current evidence
the system does not claim three independent confirmations

evals.name: Derivative conflict does not resolve by count
evals.input: Several derivative artifacts say OPEN. A current authoritative independent verification says FIXED.
expected: current authoritative evidence controls current-state determination
historical and derivative artifacts remain preserved in provenance
